newsitem.title: USA: CBOE, AMEX to list Manugistics options on June 19.
newsitem.headline: CBOE, AMEX to list Manugistics options on June 19.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange and the American Stock Exchange said Thursday they will begin trading options on Manugistics Group Inc shares on June 19.
The exchanges said initial expirations will be in July, August, October and January, with opening strike prices of 30, 35 and 40. The stock ended at 33, down 1/2, on Thursday.
At the AMEX, where TFM Investment Group will be the specialist, position limits of 7,500 contracts have been set.
The options will trade in the UAL Corp trading crowd at the CBOE.
